clips.text: Tonight, mid-fall, you realise you are dreaming — and instead of waking up, you stay, and you fly.
A moment ago, he was asleep in a dark bedroom, safe under the covers. Then the floor fell away, without a sound.
Watch him. He does not wake up. He spreads his arms — and he flies.
Over rooftops, over a sleeping city, the wind in his face — and none of it is real.
So if you can fly in a dream — why does your brain wake up inside it, and why can't you stay there all night?
One secret hides inside the dream.
Part of the brain wakes up inside the dream. Tap the video link under my name.
